post.description:
One agent run. 503 `live_mode_off` with `LIVE_MODE=off` and 429 `budget` at either
daily cap, both before anything is stored and both naming `fallback_seed`.

A new run under the parent's constraints with the chosen Qloo tag in place of the
word the parent stopped to ask about.

404 for an unknown run or a choice the ask did not offer; 422 when the run did not ask,
or asked about an act (confirm it on the venue instead). No model parse: the tag goes
straight into the constraints. The re-run is a normal agent run with every cap of
`POST /runs`, and refused like one with `LIVE_MODE=off`.

422.description: The run asked no such choice (or asked about an act).

get.description: The run's Qloo calls in order, as recorded (the API key already redacted).

schema.title: Response Get Calls Runs  Run Id  Calls Get

patch.description:
Pencil (or release) a hold on the candidate, for a night when `date` is given;
idempotent. A release clears the date. 404 when unknown, 403 on a seed run (read-only).

get.description:
The LLM-only shortlist for the run's venue and constraints: one tool-less Haiku 5.5
call the first time, then the copy cached on the run (no tokens spent).

post.description:
A new run under the parent's constraints changed as the message asks.

404 for an unknown parent; 422 when no change can be read from the message (nothing is
spent on Qloo then); 429 at either daily cap. The parse is one model call, the re-run a
normal agent run with every cap of `POST /runs`, and refused like one with `LIVE_MODE=off`.

422.description: No change can be read from the message.

get.description: Every seed in file order with its precompute state; ETag over the whole list.
The whole seed page in one read; 404 unknown slug, 409 not precomputed.

post.description: A new session on the free plan.

get.description: The session's stored plan; 404 for an unknown id.

patch.description:
Set the session's stored plan; 404 for an unknown id. Internal only: the plan flip a
payment webhook will make once checkout ships.

post.description:
Create a venue, or update one by `id`; an update drops stale resolutions and profile.
An update that changes no field is a no-op (nothing dropped, `updated_at` kept).

Record the choice and drop the profile built before it; the same choice again, already
confirmed, changes nothing and keeps the profile.

get.description:
Every pencil hold across the venue's runs (seed runs take none). 404 for an unknown
venue. Reads our own rows only: no Qloo call, no model call.

post.description:
Build and store the crowd profile; 409 while any item is unresolved or unconfirmed.
A rebuild that reads the same Qloo data as the stored profile keeps the stored row (and
its `updated_at`), so earlier runs on it stay reusable.
Resolve the venue and each past act not resolved yet (stored items are not re-asked).
